new_text: The pollination synthesis likewise showed that visible hue was not a deterministic reproductive-function state. Primary evidence included contrasting broad pollinator functions within the same visible colour, and pollination weighting could change with season, weather, or disturbance without a visible-hue change (Kunitake et al., 2004; Abe et al., 2013; Sun et al., 2017; Mori et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2025). After updating *C. oleifera* with direct bird-exclusion evidence from the same study that documented pollen toxicity (Zhang et al., 2024), the count-preserving hue–pollinator-function association remained weak in the small evidence seed (*P* = 0.77127).
